marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic marker is the existence-guarded ALTER TABLE DROP CONSTRAINT. No sidecar check kind expresses the combined outcome (constraint absent while the identical primary key remains unique): catalog_absence cannot verify the PK keeper, and exact_row_count cannot see pg_constraint definitions. The durable proof is the in-block assertion (raises if the PK on licensed_property_id and character_id is missing after the drop) plus the ON CONFLICT post-apply preview proof on issue #6411.
